_comment: Who an organisation is and is not, for the classifier (Media & Signals spec, section 2). From the 10 Oct trial. Keyed by name_key of the Registry name or an alias.

notes.note: An NGO in Udalguri district, Bodoland (BTR), Assam; livelihoods and community development in Mazbat, Udalguri and Harisinga blocks. NOT Khanij Bidesh India Ltd (a mining PSU also called KABIL).

names: Social Action for Appropriate Transformation and Advancement in Rural Areas
notes.note: An NGO based at Sipajhar, Darrang district, Assam; rural development, youth clubs. NOT a Vaishnavite 'satra' monastery (e.g. Madhupur Satra, Charabari Satra).

An NGO in Chirang district (BTR), Assam, founded 2000 by Dr Sunil Kaul and Jennifer Liang; mental health (Project MITA), weaving livelihoods, child rights. NOT the insect or other uses of the word 'ant'.

An NGO with offices at Loharghat, Kamrup Rural district, Assam and Smit, East Khasi Hills, Meghalaya; maternal health, mental health, livelihoods. NOT the Diya Foundation in Bengaluru or other namesakes outside North East India.
An NGO based in Dimapur, Nagaland working in Tuensang and Kiphire districts of Eastern Nagaland. NOT any other 'Better Life Foundation' (Kerala, Egypt, USA etc.).
An NGO in Guwahati, Assam with a centre in Tamulpur (BTR). NOT 'Muktijoddha Projonmo' or any Bangladeshi group using the word projonmo (generation).
An NGO headquartered in Tamenglong, Manipur, working in Tamenglong and Jiribam (Manipur) and Cachar (Assam).
Society for North East Handmade Paper Development, an NGO in Jorhat, Assam; handmade paper and craft livelihoods.
An NGO in Umling block, Ri-Bhoi district, Meghalaya; livelihoods across Ri-Bhoi villages.
An NGO in Bishnupur district, Manipur (Ithai Barrage-affected villages); humanitarian response, livelihoods. NOT other bodies abbreviated PRDA.
An NGO at Agia, Goalpara district, Assam.
The Delhi-based NGO founded by Anshu Gupta (material and disaster relief, rural development). NOT the Hindi word 'goonj' (echo) or events named '... Ki Goonj'.
The CSR foundation of Axis Bank (livelihoods). Axis Bank's own commercial news is NOT about the foundation.
India's largest philanthropic trusts (incl. Sir Dorabji Tata Trust, Sir Ratan Tata Trust).
The Indian philanthropic foundation of Azim Premji (education, health, grants to CSOs).
The CSR foundation of the State Bank of India. The bank's own commercial and banking news is NOT about the foundation.
The CSR foundation of Infosys. Infosys's own corporate and results news is NOT about the foundation.
